articles.summary: AI summary: The Indian Air Force says one of its IL-76MD transport planes touched down at Nyoma airfield in Ladakh, about 4,154 metres up near the Chinese border, which it describes as a world altitude record for the aircraft type. The airfield forms part of India's military build-up in the area following the deadly 2020 clash with China.

Officials say it aims to lower car prices, cut oil imports and reach 30% electric new-vehicle sales by 2030.

The crew member, one of two trainees (Muhammad Zeeshan Ali or Khurram Daud), is unnamed; China gave no launch date beyond year-end, while Ahsan Iqbal has cited November 25.
